description: 30-Day Atomic Habit micro-lessons and 4 workshop capstone sprints for Gemini Spark, Antigravity 2.0, and Antigravity CLI with offline mock-driven test harnesses.

atomic_track.title: Headless CLI Session & Keyring Auth
atomic_track.concept: Invoking Antigravity CLI in non-interactive headless mode and authenticating via mock token flags.
atomic_track.starter_bug: connect.sh omits the mandatory --headless flag, causing the command to hang waiting for an interactive TUI response.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day01.bats asserts execution terminates with exit code 0 within 5 seconds and stdout contains 'status: authenticated'.

atomic_track.title: Config Inspection & Safe Workspace Sandboxing
atomic_track.concept: Validating local .antigravity/policy.yaml configuration and workspace directory boundary enforcement.
atomic_track.starter_bug: audit_policy.sh points to an unquoted path and fails to detect missing 'allow-fs-write' permissions.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day02.bats asserts policy validation script flags insecure workspace paths with exit code 1.

atomic_track.title: Headless Codebase Context Ingestion
atomic_track.concept: Executing 'agy context index' headlessly to ingest source files into local agent cache.
atomic_track.starter_bug: index_repo.sh does not check if mock-bin/agy returned valid JSON, causing jq to fail on empty input.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day03.bats asserts jq cleanly extracts 'indexed_files_count' and returns 0 exit code.

atomic_track.title: Agent Prompt Construction & Output Redirection
atomic_track.concept: Piping structured system instructions into agy run and capturing JSON artifacts without terminal ANSI escapes.
atomic_track.starter_bug: run_prompt.sh fails to pass '--no-color', leaving raw ANSI escape sequences inside the target JSON file.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day04.bats asserts the generated output file parses as valid JSON via jq.

atomic_track.title: Python SDK Client Initialization
atomic_track.concept: Instantiating the Antigravity offline client fixture and handling missing environment variables cleanly.
atomic_track.starter_bug: client.py throws an uncaught KeyError when AGY_MOCK_ENDPOINT is unset instead of falling back to default.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day05.py asserts AntigravityClient() instantiates with default localhost mock endpoint.

atomic_track.title: Tool Schema Definition for Python Agents
atomic_track.concept: Writing JSON-schema function call definitions compatible with the Antigravity core agent harness.
atomic_track.starter_bug: tools.py omits the required 'description' and 'parameters' top-level keys in the tool declaration dict.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day06.py validates tool dictionary matches standard OpenAPI / Gemini tool schema specs.

atomic_track.title: Headless Tool Execution & Return Piping
atomic_track.concept: Executing local shell tools and returning JSON output dictionaries back into agent context.
atomic_track.starter_bug: executor.py catches stdout but ignores stderr when a tool process returns a non-zero exit status.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day07.py verifies failed tool execution raises ToolExecutionError with captured stderr.

atomic_track.title: Bash Diff Verification Before Committing
atomic_track.concept: Inspecting unified git diffs generated by an autonomous agent before staging changes.
atomic_track.starter_bug: verify_diff.sh uses 'grep' incorrectly, failing to catch forbidden file deletions ('delete mode 100644').
atomic_track.assertion: test_day08.bats tests that verify_diff.sh exits with code 1 if a diff contains file deletions.

atomic_track.title: Parsing Gemini Spark Schedule Triggers
atomic_track.concept: Configuring recurring cloud background triggers and parsing cron schedule syntax.
atomic_track.starter_bug: scheduler.py misinterprets standard 5-field cron strings, crashing on '@hourly' presets.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day09.py tests parsing both 5-part cron strings and convenience alias macros.

atomic_track.title: Designing Teachable Skills for Spark
atomic_track.concept: Defining persistent behavioral skills in JSON format for the Gemini Spark agent engine.
atomic_track.starter_bug: skill_manifest.py produces invalid parameter typings, confusing 'string' with Python 'str' in JSON schema.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day10.py validates exported skill JSON against the Spark Teachable Skill schema.

atomic_track.title: Headless CLI Session Exporting
atomic_track.concept: Exporting terminal conversation history to an Antigravity 2.0 workspace archive using 'agy export'.
atomic_track.starter_bug: export_session.sh hardcodes the output path to /tmp without checking write permissions.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day11.bats verifies exported .agy-session file is created in the user-specified target path.

atomic_track.title: Multi-File Patch Application via Script
atomic_track.concept: Applying agent-generated unidiff patches cleanly across a staging directory.
atomic_track.starter_bug: apply_patch.sh runs 'patch -p0' instead of 'patch -p1', causing path lookup failures.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day12.bats confirms git working tree is cleanly patched without rejecting hunks.

atomic_track.title: Agent Guardrails: Token Budgets & Step Caps
atomic_track.concept: Implementing iteration bounds on autonomous agent execution loops to avoid runaway API costs.
atomic_track.starter_bug: loop.py uses while True without decrementing the max_steps counter variable.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day13.py asserts agent loop terminates with MaxStepsExceeded when reaching step limit.

atomic_track.title: BATS Test Runner Assertions for CLI Commands
atomic_track.concept: Writing robust automated test assertions for custom CLI wrapper scripts.
atomic_track.starter_bug: test_wrapper.bats checks '$status' before calling 'run', causing testing against the wrong command.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day14.bats passes self-test verifying correct order of execution for BATS assertions.

atomic_track.title: Connecting Workspace MCP Protocols
atomic_track.concept: Establishing a standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) transport connection to local mock tools.
atomic_track.starter_bug: mcp_client.py fails to send the mandatory initialize JSON-RPC handshake before issuing tool calls.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day15.py confirms proper JSON-RPC handshake request and response parsing.

atomic_track.title: Automated Linting via Agent CLI
atomic_track.concept: Triggering headless agent code repair on flake8/ruff linting failures.
atomic_track.starter_bug: auto_lint.sh fails to pass the exit code of ruff to the agent trigger condition.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day16.bats confirms the agent is only invoked if linting returns exit code 1.

atomic_track.title: Handling Spark Persistent Memory & State Dumps
atomic_track.concept: Serializing and restoring agent memory context between distinct execution runs.
atomic_track.starter_bug: state_manager.py overwrites existing state files on initialization instead of appending or merging.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day17.py verifies previous context keys are preserved across reloads.

atomic_track.title: Headless Error Recovery & Retry Loops
atomic_track.concept: Implementing exponential backoff inside shell scripts invoking agent operations.
atomic_track.starter_bug: retry.sh uses a fixed delay and does not increment backoff multiplier on HTTP 429.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day18.bats validates exponential sleep intervals across 3 simulated failure attempts.

atomic_track.title: Python Test-Driven Development (TDD) Agent Loop
atomic_track.concept: Writing an autonomous loop that reads pytest outputs and attempts targeted bug fixes.
atomic_track.starter_bug: tdd_agent.py does not parse pytest summary lines to extract failed test names.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day19.py asserts parser extracts failing node IDs from simulated pytest output.

atomic_track.title: Safe File Deletion Policies in Antigravity
atomic_track.concept: Verifying repository safety flags preventing unintended file deletion by LLM agents.
atomic_track.starter_bug: delete_guard.sh returns 0 even when 'allow_delete: false' is violated.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day20.bats asserts delete_guard returns exit code 1 when detecting deletion of protected files.

atomic_track.title: Spark Web Browsing Skill Simulation
atomic_track.concept: Simulating headless browser DOM extraction queries for Gemini Spark research tasks.
atomic_track.starter_bug: dom_parser.py strips text nodes while removing script tags due to an incorrect regex quantifier.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day21.py validates extraction of article body without script/style contamination.

atomic_track.title: Sanitizing Agent Output for Shell Execution
atomic_track.concept: Preventing shell injection when running shell commands generated by an LLM agent.
atomic_track.starter_bug: sanitize.sh evaluates raw agent string using 'eval $COMMAND' without validation.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day22.bats asserts dangerous characters (;, |, `) are caught and rejected.

atomic_track.title: Streaming Output Buffering in Terminal
atomic_track.concept: Handling chunked NDJSON streaming from the agent backend without tearing lines in the terminal.
atomic_track.starter_bug: stream.py prints raw chunks directly without buffering incomplete newline-delimited JSON tokens.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day23.py confirms fragmented JSON chunks are properly buffered before rendering.

atomic_track.title: Generating Git Commit Messages via Agent
atomic_track.concept: Inspecting staged changes and generating Conventional Commits messages headlessly.
atomic_track.starter_bug: commit_gen.sh stages all untracked files instead of only diffing currently staged files.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day24.bats verifies only staged changes are evaluated for the commit message.

atomic_track.title: Multi-Agent Conversation State Passing
atomic_track.concept: Handing off task payloads from an Antigravity CLI planning agent to a Python execution agent.
atomic_track.starter_bug: handoff.py drops metadata headers containing original user instructions during payload serialize.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day25.py verifies metadata and prompt history are preserved across the boundary.

atomic_track.title: Codespaces Healthcheck Scripting
atomic_track.concept: Verifying container prerequisites (Python version, bats, git, mock-bin PATH) upon Codespace boot.
atomic_track.starter_bug: healthcheck.sh checks global PATH but forgets to test if mock-bin/agy has executable permissions.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day26.bats ensures healthcheck fails if mock-bin/agy is missing '+x' permissions.

atomic_track.title: Spark Email Digest Template Engine
atomic_track.concept: Generating concise Markdown and HTML digests from simulated email thread JSON fixtures.
atomic_track.starter_bug: digest.py crashes when an email thread contains zero messages instead of handling empty lists.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day27.py asserts empty threads render 'No unread messages' fallback.

atomic_track.title: Headless Multi-File Refactor Auditing
atomic_track.concept: Auditing agent modifications across multiple subfolders to ensure scope containment.
atomic_track.starter_bug: audit_scope.sh only inspects the current directory and misses changes in nested subdirectories.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day28.bats asserts modified files outside the target directory flag a scope boundary error.

atomic_track.title: Agent Benchmark Metric Reporting
atomic_track.concept: Calculating success rate, latency, and step efficiency from test run logs.
atomic_track.starter_bug: metrics.py divides by total tasks without checking for zero, causing ZeroDivisionError on empty logs.
atomic_track.assertion: pytest test_day29.py verifies graceful return of 0.0 metrics on empty or unpopulated logs.

atomic_track.title: Capstone Atomic Challenge: Full CI Self-Check
atomic_track.concept: Chaining bats test suites and pytest harnesses into a unified local pre-push validation script.
atomic_track.starter_bug: ci_check.sh exits immediately after running bats, ignoring the pytest test suite altogether.
atomic_track.assertion: test_day30.bats confirms ci_check.sh executes both test frameworks and aggregates final exit codes.

sprint_track.title: Headless CLI Orchestration & Automated Code Doctor
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Build a command-line utility in Bash and Python that runs test suites headlessly via mock agy, captures test errors, and invokes the agent to repair broken code until all tests pass.
sprint_track.pytest_criteria: tests/test_module01.py runs doctor.sh against a broken fixture project, mocks the agy fix cycle, and verifies all tests pass within 3 iterations.

sprint_track.title: Gemini Spark 24/7 Workspace Assistant Simulator
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Implement an always-on background worker in Python that consumes scheduled triggers, evaluates incoming simulated Gmail/Calendar events, and executes persistent skills via tool calls.
sprint_track.pytest_criteria: tests/test_module02.py asserts daemon processes mock queue events, triggers appropriate skills, and logs execution records without memory leaks.

sprint_track.title: Antigravity 2.0 Multi-Agent Code Review & PR Bot
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Create a multi-agent review pipeline that evaluates git diffs, checks compliance against a security checklist, generates suggested git patches, and posts formatted markdown feedback.
sprint_track.pytest_criteria: tests/test_module03.py asserts reviewer flags security policy violations and produces syntactically valid unified diff patches.

sprint_track.title: End-to-End Autonomous Software Factory
sprint_track.capstone_goal: Build a complete multi-agent workflow integrating Gemini Spark (trigger & requirements decomposition), Antigravity CLI (headless code implementation), and Antigravity IDE (session export & verification) into a unified GitHub Actions pipeline.
sprint_track.pytest_criteria: tests/test_module04.py validates the full pipeline execution from raw feature spec to committed, passing code in a headless container environment.
